tytul: Cold-smoked salmon: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for salmon smoked at home with cold smoke.

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to the FDA, C. botulinum type E, and nonproteolytic types B and F, can grow and form toxin at temperatures as low as 38 °F (3.3 °C).
According to a University of Alaska guide to smoking fish, cold-smoke temperatures are not hot enough to kill bacteria and may even help them grow.
…so the product can spoil or become unsafe to eat before it is fully smoked.
Even vacuum-packed smoked fish must be kept in the refrigerator or freezer, never at room temperature.

akapity: According to the FDA, C. botulinum type E is the most common form in fresh water and the sea, and it should be assumed to be present in any raw fish, especially in the guts.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for cold-smoked salmon from a checked source.
